🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation with Energy, Healthcare and Financials ABOVE TREND, and mixed leadership among mega-cap Tech where AAPL/MSFT are ABOVE TREND while NVDA/GOOGL are BELOW TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leading: XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Materials weak and Utilities weak on 1W; Industrials mixed with BA (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -8.05%) BELOW TREND. Sector internal rotation visible despite overall positive breadth.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +6.99% | 1M: +14.11%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.87% | 1M: +6.28%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) indicating cross-sector participation.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -11.26%) BELOW TREND, DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION, TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.00%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%), ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%), MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%). Major divergence present among large caps (META, JNJ, DHR showing 1W down vs 1M up) — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE and signals tactical moves rather than confirmed regime shifts.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is soft on both 1W and 1M (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -1.37%) with major names split: AAPL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND. Sector shows internal rotation; watch for follow-through in chip-equipment stocks.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive with mixed dispersion: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +6.63%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -1.00%) BELOW TREND. Breadth within Financials supports a Value/Cyclical tilt but select names are under pressure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing strength overall (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +7.07%) with ABT (1W: +12.84% | 1M: +13.54%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND, while ISRG (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND flags dispersion. Sector breadth supportive of risk-on exposure within healthcare names.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Financials/Healthcare cyclicals (XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +10.04%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to lagging Tech hardware/equipment names (LRCX, AMAT, TXN) and monitor large-cap divergences; style: Value/Cyclical tilt over pure Growth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND — catalysts confirm price action. BEARISH: DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -17.23%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND — watch for trend continuation.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy — sector up on 1W and strong names ABOVE TREND (XOM, CVX). BEARISH: Technology and Materials — 1W weakness and several equipment names BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -2.13% | 1M: -1.61%) BELOW TREND — needs sustained weekly strength to signal stabilization. AAPL (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — hold as relative strength barometer for Tech. DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through after earnings weakness.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+75): PayPal takeover headlines; PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. MMM (+85): beat-and-raise; MMM (1W: +9.06% | 1M: +6.33%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. ABBV (+60): EU approval headlines; ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND — confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
DHR (-60): “surprisingly soft” segment; DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION — sentiment confirmed by sharp 1W drop. LLY (-50): GLP-1 lawsuit headline; LLY (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — news diverges from price, monitor for flow change. WBD (-) flagged in headlines but WBD (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND and shows confirming weakness despite some bullish M&A coverage.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. PYPL (1W: +17.90% | 1M: +31.38%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +10.09%) ABOVE TREND and ABBV (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +19.14%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps—META (1W: -2.61% | 1M: +11.54%) CORRECTION and DHR (1W: -10.07% | 1M: +1.25%) CORRECTION and negative news on LLY despite price strength—watch for trend break.
